title: Credential-request investigation
text: For an OTP, PIN or password request, preserve the message and identify whether it requests disclosure or warns against disclosure. Verify the sender through an independent trusted channel. Never request the customer's secret code. A message alone does not establish that a payment is fraudulent.

title: Near-threshold transfer review
text: For repeated transfers just below a configured monitoring threshold, review the aggregate amount, time window, recipients and legitimate business purpose. Compare with prior activity. Splitting payments is an indicator to investigate; intent cannot be established from amounts alone. Simulation thresholds are not legal reporting thresholds.

title: Rapid forwarding and mule indicators
text: For an account receiving funds from multiple sources and rapidly forwarding funds, examine incoming and outgoing timestamps, amounts and counterparties. Seek a plausible payment purpose and independently verified context. Shared devices and rapid transfers are unconfirmed indicators, not proof that the account owner is a money mule.

title: Circular transfers and relationships
text: When transfers form a circular account path, inspect the underlying transaction records and timing. Check whether refunds, settlement or related businesses explain the cycle. Graph connections indicate relationships only and must not be treated as proof of criminal activity.

title: Velocity and anomaly review
text: For unusually frequent transfers or anomaly scores, compare recent activity with the account's historical baseline, age and known payment purpose. Confirm the device and transaction timing. Unusual behavior can be legitimate; an anomaly score is not a confirmed fraud label.

title: Human case review and outcomes
text: An authorized analyst reviews evidence, records a rationale and chooses confirmed fraud, legitimate activity or inconclusive. Preserve the original model version and supporting evidence. Do not resolve a case solely on an AI-generated narrative. This simulation never blocks funds or submits regulatory reports.

title: Evidence handling and privacy
text: Use synthetic examples in the public demonstration. Store only information needed for investigation, restrict case access to authorized analysts and retain an audit history. Do not include OTP values, passwords or unnecessary personal information in notes. Production retention periods require an organization-approved policy.
